title: Source registers for copy operations
statement: For each copy-operation site, assign a source register among the 18 registers as follows: multiplication into the counter uses the power register when the Boolean parameter is true and the base register otherwise; multiplication into the accumulator and setup of the radius use the power register; setup, root, push, and both pop-count operations use the width register; popping the stack into the accumulator uses the stack register, and moving the halved stack into the quotient register uses the accumulator register.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a copy-operation site
